references.text: Psalm 37:11 also speaks of the humble who will inherit the land, which reflects the promise in Matthew 5:5.
Proverbs 2:9 highlights the way of righteousness and the righteous, which can be seen in connection with those who are 'praeis' (meek) in Matthew 5:5.
Micah 5:5 also contains a promise of peace, which can be associated with the 'praeis' (meek) who inherit the earth in Matthew 5:5.
